newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: South African business welcomes Mandela's speech.
newsitem.headline: South African business welcomes Mandela's speech.

text.p: The South African Chamber of Business has welcomed President Nelson Mandela's emphasis on the important aspects of government's macro-economic strategy and hoped for more details in the budget in March.

Reacting to Mandela's opening of parliament speech earlier on Friday, the chamber (Sacob) said it also shared Mandela's emphasis on the Growth, Employment and Redistribution strategy which it saw as a prime agent for the future delivery of both social and economic goals.
"Sacob particularly welcome the emphasis on...the continued commitment to the lifting of exchange controls, privatisation, fiscal discipline and prudent monetary policy," it said.
Mandela earlier pledged his government's commitment to the privatisation of key state assets and reaffirmed its commitment to the phased removal of exchange controls.
"Business hopes that more specific details as to how that strategy will be implemented will be announced in the March budget and through economic policy measures to be introduced this year," it said.
Government will present its budget on March 12.
